Name: Music Browser Menu (MBM)
Author: invatorzen
Description:
[center]
[size=6][b][color=#c586c0]♪ MUSIC BROWSER MENU ♪[/color][/b][/size]
[i]Check every track in the valley — without missing a beat.[/i]
[/center]

[line]

[size=5][color=#c586c0][b]▎ What is it?[/b][/color][/size]

[b]Music Browser Menu[/b] was made to help me determine what songs to use in my heart events, without the need of scrolling through the google sheet and looking at previews on soundcloud, youtube, etc. Now, you can open an in-game window that lets you search, sort, and preview every music track in the game. Play your favorite song, or find that one tune that perfectly fits your events — and when you're done, your original music picks right back up where it left off.

[line]

[size=5][color=#c586c0][b]▎ Features[/b][/color][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Every playable track[/b] — the full music library, resolved to readable names instead of raw cue IDs.[/*]
[*][b]Search[/b] — type part of a name or ID and jump straight to it.[/*]
[*][b]Sort[/b] — order the list by ID (ascending or descending) or alphabetically by name.[/*]
[*][b]Instant preview[/b] — click to play, click [b]Stop[/b] whenever; the currently playing track is always displayed.[/*]
[*][b]No disruption[/b] — closing the menu [i]restores whatever was playing before[/i], so your game's music is never left hanging.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][color=#c586c0][b]▎ How to use[/b][/color][/size]

[list]
[*]Press [b][color=#ce9178]F10[/color][/b] in-game to open the browser.[/*]
[*]Prefer another key? Change [b]OpenMusicKey[/b] in the mod's [color=#dcdcaa]config.json[/color] (or via Generic Mod Config Menu if available).[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][color=#c586c0][b]▎ Perfect for[/b][/color][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Mod authors[/b] picking background music for events, festivals, or locations.[/*]
[*][b]Players[/b] who want to find and enjoy a specific track.[/*]
[*]Anyone curious what's hiding in the game's soundtrack.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][color=#c586c0][b]▎ Compatibility[/b][/color][/size]

[list]
[*]Requires [b]SMAPI 4.0.0[/b] or newer.[/*]
[*]Preview-only — it never edits your music data or your save.[/*]
[*]Picks up custom tracks from other mods automatically.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Music Browser Menu
Manifest.Description: Preview, search, and sort every music track in the game from an in-game menu; restores your original music when you close it.
Manifest.Author: Invatorzen
